[[File:GTASA-Soundtrack.jpg|thumb|Artwork to ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas: Official Soundtrack'' CD.]]
'''''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas: Official Soundtrack''''' is a three-disc compilation CD/DVD set containing a selection of music from the video game ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''. It includes songs from each of the game's ten music [[Radio Stations in GTA San Andreas|radio stations]], plus the "[[Theme from San Andreas]]". It was released internationally on November 23, 2004.

In addition to music, the CD also includes a bonus DVD containing the short film prequel ''[[The Introduction]]''.

A more comprehensive [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas: Official Soundtrack Box Set|soundtrack box set]] was also released in Europe on December 7, 2004, containing the majority of the music heard in the game.

==Notes==
*The "[[Theme from San Andreas]]" and the bonus ''The Introduction'' DVD are exclusive to this compilation, and were not included in the ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas: Official Soundtrack Box Set]]''. The songs "Break 4 Love" by Raze and "Head Like a Hole" by AFI are also not featured in the full set, but are readily available elsewhere.
*The song "Head Like a Hole" by AFI does not actually appear in the game.
